benchmarks.name: deepset
benchmarks.title: deepset prompt-injections
benchmarks.measures: prompt injection detection, English and German

benchmarks.name: gandalf

benchmarks.name: jbb
benchmarks.title: JailbreakBench behaviors
benchmarks.measures: 100 harmful behaviours vs 100 topic-matched benign ones
benchmarks.citation: Chao et al. (2024), JailbreakBench, NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks

benchmarks.name: xstest
benchmarks.title: XSTest v2

benchmarks.name: notinject
benchmarks.title: NotInject (InjecGuard)
benchmarks.measures: over-defence: benign prompts deliberately containing injection trigger words (benign only)

benchmarks.name: toxicchat
benchmarks.title: ToxicChat 0124
benchmarks.measures: real user prompts to a public chatbot: toxicity and jailbreaking, at their natural base rate
benchmarks.citation: Lin et al. (2023), ToxicChat, EMNLP Findings

benchmarks.measures: attacker instructions embedded in tool responses (reviews, emails, notes) vs the same responses with benign content
benchmarks.citation: Zhan et al. (2024), InjecAgent, ACL Findings
